title: Zero Trust Browser interactive reports: where they are and which widgets each report has
aliases: File and Document in Isolation report

prose.text: What the reports do not state is open {{gap:report-scope}}.

checks.do: Whether the report being read is one of the four named reports and which widgets that report has.

default-interactive-reports.statement: Any organization that uses Zero Trust Browser automatically sees default Internet & SaaS interactive reports, found under Analytics > Reports > Interactive Reports in the Browser Isolation section, and they work like the Interactive Reports for Internet & SaaS.

quotes: Any organization that uses Zero Trust Browser automatically sees these default reports for Internet & SaaS.
All functions of the Zero Trust Browser reports are the same as the functions of the Interactive Reports for Internet & SaaS.
Scroll down to the Browser Isolation section.
go to Analytics > Reports > Interactive Reports

four-report-types.statement: The Zero Trust Browser interactive reports consist of Consumption, Isolation Traffic Summary Overview, Security Overview, and File and Document in Isolation.

quotes: consist of data for Consumption, Isolation Traffic Summary Overview, Security Overview, and File and Document in Isolation.

consumption-widgets.statement: The Consumption report has widgets for overall traffic trend, overall data volume, isolated data volume, unique isolated users and the policies that enforced isolation (Policy Reason).

quotes: Overall Traffic Trend in Isolation: This widget shows the overall trend for web traffic.
Overall Data Volume: This widget shows the volume of data accessed by users.
Isolated Data Volume: This widget shows the volume of data accessed via the isolation container.
Unique Isolated Users: This widget shows the number of unique users in isolation.
Policy Reason: This widget shows which policies enforced isolation.
Consumption: This report shows an overview of how your organization is consuming Zero Trust Browser as a service and includes the following widgets:

traffic-summary-widgets.statement: The Isolation Traffic Summary Overview report includes widgets for top URL supercategories, top URL categories, cloud applications, cloud application classes, top users and top departments (by bandwidth utilized) and top locations from which traffic is redirected to isolation.

quotes: Top URL Supercategories in Isolation: This widget shows the most commonly accessed web pages based on popular content.
Top URL Categories in Isolation: This widget shows the most commonly accessed web pages based on general content.
Top Users Using Isolation: This widget shows the top users of isolation based on the bandwidth utilized.
Top Departments in Isolation: This widget shows the top departments of isolation based on the bandwidth utilized.
Top Locations in Isolation: This widget shows the locations from which traffic is redirected to isolation.
Cloud Applications in Isolation: This widget shows which cloud-based applications are accessed via isolation.
Top Cloud Application Classes in Isolation: This widget shows which cloud-based application classes are accessed the most via isolation.
Isolation Traffic Summary Overview: This report shows an overview of the web traffic being isolated for your organization and includes the following widgets:

security-and-file-widgets.statement: The Security Overview report shows weekly top threats, monthly top advanced threats and two monthly Sandbox widgets; the File and Document in Isolation report shows the types and quantities of files uploaded from and downloaded to isolation.

quotes: Weekly Top Threats in Isolation This Week: This widget shows the most common threats detected within isolation on a weekly basis.
Monthly Top Advanced Threats in Isolation This Month: This widget shows the most common advanced threats detected within isolation on a monthly basis.
The Sandbox Action in Isolation This Month: This widget shows what actions were taken when users' isolation environments were sandboxed on a monthly basis.
Files Uploaded from Isolation: This widget shows the types and quantities of files that users uploaded within isolation.
Files Downloaded to Isolation: This widget shows the types and quantities of files that users downloaded within isolation.
The Sandbox in Isolation This Month: This widget shows how many users' isolation environments were sandboxed on a monthly basis.
Security Overview: This report shows an overview of the security events and trends that were detected in the isolated web traffic for your organization and includes the following widgets:

File and Document in Isolation: This report shows an overview of the files that users in the organization uploaded, downloaded, or viewed while using Zero Trust Browser and includes the following widgets:

report-scope.title: How far back the isolation reports retain data
report-scope.detail: The reports article says the isolation reports work exactly like the Internet & SaaS Interactive Reports, so time frame, filters and export are those in [[zia.reports.interactive]]. The article gives no retention period. The File and Document in Isolation report is introduced as covering files uploaded, downloaded or viewed, but the article lists upload and download widgets only.
report-scope.blocks: saying how far back the isolation reports go
